NVDA.name: NVIDIA Corporation
NVDA.ai_strategy_one_line_zh: 以数据中心规模AI基础设施为核心，通过全栈平台驱动各行业AI转型。
NVDA.ai_strategy_one_line_en: Data center-scale AI infrastructure platform reshaping all industries via full-stack acceleration.
concrete_bets: AI models and training data sets

MSFT.name: Microsoft Corporation
MSFT.ai_strategy_one_line_zh: 全面整合AI到每个技术层，以智能云和智能边缘赋能客户，并负责任地推广。
MSFT.ai_strategy_one_line_en: Integrate AI across the entire technology stack to empower customers with intelligent cloud and edge, responsibly.

PLTR.name: Palantir Technologies Inc.
PLTR.ai_strategy_one_line_zh: 将AI集成到其Gotham、Foundry和Apollo平台中，并通过AIP平台提供可操作的决策支持。
PLTR.ai_strategy_one_line_en: Integrate AI into core platforms via AIP for actionable decision-making.

META.name: Meta Platforms, Inc.
META.ai_strategy_one_line_zh: 以AI赋能社交、内容推荐与下一代计算平台，推出Meta AI助手及智能眼镜。
META.ai_strategy_one_line_en: Integrate AI across social, discovery, and next-gen computing via Meta AI and wearables.
